N29_legitimate_root_range.statement: For N=29 every legitimate nonempty root has r0<=13.
proof: Nonempty gives m0>=1 and full coverage gives L0>=r0.

r9_canonical_exclusion_and_degree1.statement: Every legitimate unit-free N=29 root with r0=9 contains a degree-1 variable.
proof: If m0>=2 then L0<=17<18=2*r0, hence the degree-1 lemma applies.
If m0=1 then L0=18. But one canonical clause over 9 live variables contains at most one signed literal per variable, hence has width at most 9, contradicting L0=18.
Therefore every legitimate r0=9 root has m0>=2 and a degree-1 variable.

high_r_degree1_corridor.statement: For every legitimate N=29 root with r0>=10, a degree-1 live variable exists.
proof: Hence L0<2*r0 and the degree-1 lemma applies.

degree1_elimination_reroot.statement: At a unit-free ordinary stage, eliminating a degree-1 pivot creates no resolvents and reduces local input-size units by at least four, hence for N=29 the residual local size N'<=25.
proof: A degree-1 pivot occurs in exactly one clause and one polarity, so one resolution bucket is empty.
Deleting the clause removes one clause unit, at least two literal units, and at least the pivot variable.

cap_monotonicity.statement: The inherited N'<=25 theorem proves ordinary availability under local cap at most 25^2=625. The frozen N=29 run retains cap 29^2=841, so inherited certified steps remain available.

theorem.name: NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N29
theorem.statement: For N<=28 inherit the proved corridor. At N=29, roots with r0<=8 are certified by the existing exact recurrence. The r0=9 boundary is forced into the degree-1 corridor because the sole non-degree1 arithmetic cell m0=1 would require one canonical clause of width 18 over only 9 variables and is impossible. Roots with r0>=10 satisfy L0<2*r0 directly. Degree-1 elimination re-roots at local size at most 25, inside the proved N<=25 corridor. Therefore v2/v3 cannot be required because of ordinary raw-cap unavailability for any legitimate root with N<=29.

next_exact_target: Advance the frozen-grammar frontier to N=30. Preserve heuristic-free theorem runtime and use only already-proved exact structural/raw-budget invariants until a genuine reachable gap appears.
